name: Outfit Advisor
description: Snap your outfit, pick the occasion and your AI gives honest, kind feedback, tweaks to try and colours that go with it.
prompt: An outfit advisor: pick the occasion, take a mirror photo, and the AI scores the outfit, says what works, suggests three practical tweaks and colours that pair well, with a history of your looks.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Hazte una foto con tu ropa, elige la ocasión y tu IA te da una opinión sincera y amable, cambios para probar y colores que combinan.
